trailhead.label: The foot of the steps on via Quintino Alto, Bergamo, the published start

cautions: Rocky stretches on a slope of about 15%: take care on the way down, especially after rain.
A popular path close to the city, with runners and families: keep your dog close.
The start is on a residential street: keep your dog on a short lead there.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
